description:
[read-only] The social accounts a brand can post to — the same set publish would use for that `brandId`: platform, handle, display name, health (healthy, needs_reauth, disconnected) and whether flayr can post there right now (`postable`; Reddit is paused because Reddit closed its API to third-party apps). Call this before publish to pick platforms, and tell the user to reconnect any account that is not healthy at flayr.social/connect.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/accounts.)

brandId.description: An id from GET /api/v2/brands, or "personal". Omitted → the key's bound brand, else the owner's personal accounts.

name: list_connected_accounts
title: List connected social accounts
